findings.evidence: .github/pull_request_template.md:12-17: 'replace each `…` below with `changed`, `checked`, `declined` or `n/a`, a dash, and a note'; 'A line with a finding you have not fixed begins `declined`'.
findings.fix: Begin the Q3 line with `declined —` and keep the per-hypothesis notes. Editing only the description does not start a new review, so reply on this thread once it is updated.
findings.issue: The Q3 line reads `- Q3 Hypotheses (k = 1, p = 2 counterexamples use ...):` and starts with no status word. Several hypotheses on it are kept for other reasons (`hp`, `hU`, `hUΩ`, `hg`, `huc`, `CompleteSpace`: 'declined - ...'), and the template says those belong on a line that begins `declined`.

findings.evidence: PR description Q3 bullet: '`tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_of_tendsto_eLpNormWkp_of_two_lt_mul`. `hkp`: ... `huc`: ... `hu₀c`: ... `hp`: declined ...'. There is no `hlim`, although the diff signature has `(hlim : ∀ K ⊆ (Ω : Set ℂ), IsCompact K → ...)`.
findings.fix: Add `hlim` to that entry with a counterexample, e.g. `uₙ = 1` and `u₀ = 0`, which are continuous but do not converge. Editing only the description does not start a new review, so reply on this thread once it is updated.
findings.issue: The Q3 entry for `tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_of_tendsto_eLpNormWkp_of_two_lt_mul` covers `hkp`, `huc`, `hu₀c` and `hp` but leaves out `hlim`, which therefore has neither a counterexample nor a `declined` reason.

summary: The Quality pass block is present, but the Q3 line starts with no status word even though it keeps hypotheses for reasons other than counterexamples. Its entry for one theorem leaves out a hypothesis entirely.
